title: Lines keep their prices when a tier they follow is archived
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, the next tier after tier A, on Same as previous tier in matrix A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, Default 50% markup, tier A 10% off.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier B for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A. It has a part with a cost of $100.00 in category A, priced $135.00 by tier B through tier A.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Archive.
  4. Click Archive in the dialog.
  5. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The menu offers Archive.

Step 3:

  • The Archive question lists tier B.

Step 4:

  • Tier A is archived.

Step 5:

  • The part line still reads $135.00 = $100.00 × 1.50 × 0.90.
